title: Air amplicon sequencing
description: Air samples were collected from two adjacent villages for one year in rural China, comprising an improved village that implemented comprehensive rural environmental improvement (REI) interventions (including waste and sewage management) and an unimproved control village. The study aimed to investigate the effects of REI on airborne microbial communities and potential pathogens.
